name: Mystic Tomato
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

name: Viser Des
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, select 1 monster your opponent controls. Destroy that monster during your 3rd Standby Phase after the Summon. This card cannot be destroyed by battle until this effect is resolved.

name: Legendary Fiend
extDescription: During each of your Standby Phases, this card gains 700 ATK.

name: Dark Jeroid
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned successfully, select 1 face-up monster on the field. As long as the monster remains face-up on the field, decrease its ATK by 800 points.

name: Newdoria
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy 1 monster on the field.

name: Gravekeeper's Spy
extDescription: FLIP: Special Summon 1 Gravekeeper's monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

name: Gravekeeper's Curse
extDescription: When this monster is Summoned, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Guard
extDescription: FLIP: Return 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field to its owner's hand.

name: Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier
extDescription: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Gravekeeper's Chief
extDescription: You can only control 1 Gravekeeper's Chief at a time. Your Graveyard is unaffected by Necrovalley. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can Special Summon 1 Gravekeeper's monster from your Graveyard.

name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder", to inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
extDescription: You cannot activate this card's effect unless Necrovalley is on the field. When this card declares an attack, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Lava Golem
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon or Set the turn you Special Summon this card. The controller of this card takes 1000 points of damage during each of his/her Standby Phases.

name: Drillago
extDescription: When there are only face-up monsters with ATK 1600 or more on your opponent's side of the field, this monster can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Bowganian
extDescription: During each of your Standby Phases, inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Gravekeeper's Commandant
extDescription: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 Necrovalley from your Deck to your hand.

name: Gravekeeper's Visionary
extDescription: You can Normal Summon this card by Tributing 1 Gravekeeper's monster. This card gains 200 ATK for each Gravekeeper's monster in your Graveyard. If this face-up card on the field would be destroyed, you can discard 1 Gravekeeper's monster instead.

name: Gravekeeper's Descendant
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 face-up Gravekeeper's monster you control, except this card, to destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

name: Mystical Space Typhoon
extDescription: Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Nightmare's Steelcage
extDescription: This card remains face-up on the field for 2 of your opponent's turns. No monsters can attack. Destroy this card during your opponent's 2nd End Phase after this card was activated.

name: Creature Swap
extDescription: Each player selects 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: Book of Moon
extDescription: Flip 1 face-up monster on the field into face-down Defense Position.

name: Dark Room of Nightmare
extDescription: Each time damage, except Battle Damage, is inflicted to your opponent's Life Points, inflict 300 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. This card's effect is not applied to the effect of Dark Room of Nightmare.

name: Necrovalley
extDescription:
All Gravekeeper's monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in either player's Graveyard cannot be banished. Cards in either player's Graveyard cannot be affected by card effects, except for their own effects.

(Red text indicates errata.)

name: Foolish Burial
extDescription: Select 1 monster from your Deck and send it to the Graveyard.

name: Magical Stone Excavation
extDescription: Discard 2 cards. Add 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Allure of Darkness
extDescription: Draw 2 cards, then remove from play 1 DARK monster from your hand. If you don't have any DARK monsters in your hand to remove, send all cards in your hand to the Graveyard.

name: Acid Trap Hole
extDescription: Select 1 face-down Defense Position monster. Flip it face-up, and if the DEF of the monster is 2000 points or less, destroy the monster. If the DEF is more than 2000 points, return the monster to face-down Defense Position.

name: Mirror Force
extDescription: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.

name: Skull Invitation
extDescription: Each time a card is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 300 points of damage to its owner's Life Points per card.

name: Coffin Seller
extDescription: Each time Monster Card(s) are sent to your opponent's Graveyard, inflict 300 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Nightmare Wheel
extDescription: Select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the selected monster cannot attack or change its battle position. During each of your Standby Phases, this card inflicts 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. When the selected monster is removed from the field, destroy this card.

name: Metal Reflect Slime
extDescription: After activation, Special Summon this card in Defense Position,  it is treated as an Effect Monster Card (Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 10/ATK 0/DEF 3000). This card cannot attack. (This card is also still treated as a Trap Card.)

name: Malevolent Catastrophe
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack. Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards.

name: Dark Illusion
extDescription: Negate the activation of a Spell Card, Trap Card, or Effect Monster's effect that targets a face-up DARK monster, and destroy that card.

name: Mystical Beast of Serket
extDescription: If this monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle, that monster is removed from play, and this card gains 500 ATK. If you do not control a face-up Temple of the Kings, this monster is destroyed.

name: Temple of the Kings
extDescription: You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set. You can send 1 “Mystical Beast of Serket” in your Monster Zone and this card you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck, or 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of “Temple of the Kings” once per turn.
